SpotMenu - Spotify and iTunes in your menu bar.

summary.one_liner: SpotMenu is a macOS menu bar app, built with Swift and SwiftUI, that shows the currently playing track from Spotify or Apple Music with playback controls and global keyboard shortcuts.
summary.what_it_does: It displays the artist and song title in the menu bar and offers a hover overlay on a playback panel with play/pause, skip, and album art. Global hotkeys control playback, and an optional Spotify Web API integration lets you like or unlike tracks. Users can pick Automatic, Spotify, or Apple Music as the player source. Menu bar options include showing or hiding text and icons, a compact view, and a max width setting. Overlay colors, blur, and opacity can also be adjusted.
use_cases: see what song is playing from the menu bar
control Spotify or Apple Music without switching windows
set global hotkeys for play, pause, and skip
like or unlike Spotify tracks from the desktop
keep a compact now-playing display on macOS
notable: Menu bar now-playing display with a hover overlay for playback controls
Global keyboard shortcuts for playback and liking
Auto-detects or manually selects Spotify or Apple Music
Signed, notarized builds with automatic updates via Sparkle
caveats: Track liking works only with Spotify and requires creating a Spotify Developer App and entering its Client ID
Build from source requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later and Xcode 15 or later
keywords: display artist and song in menubar
